title: Wiki page frontmatter
description: The contract every curated wiki page declares. Four governance axes travel with the page, are carried onto each chunk the page produces, and are filterable at retrieval time. Everything else a wiki keeps in frontmatter is allowed through untouched: two wikis with different local conventions both validate against this.

type.description: Page class in the owning wiki's own taxonomy (layer, scenario, concept, source, entity, framework, comparison, reference, vocabulary, rule, exemplar, overview...). Free-form by design: the governance axes below, not this, are what the platform enforces.

ownership_layer.description: Which repository owns the page. 'upstream' is the shared wiki every twin pulls from; 'local' is material a single twin keeps because the shared wiki would reject it. This answers WHO MAY EDIT. It is deliberately NOT the same field as a chunk's source_layer, which answers whether content was curated or arrived raw and already drives a ranking discount. Conflating the two would change ranking with no visible signal.

editorial_standing.description: How far the page has moved through review. Ascending: drafted, read by a second person, signed off by someone accountable for it.

evidence_class.description: What kind of claim the page makes. 'source_backed' is traceable to an ingested document; 'interpretive' is synthesis beyond what a source states; 'demo_invented' is written to illustrate and describes nothing real; 'provisional' is expected to change. Omitted means it is derived from the page's provenance tags or type — see wiki_frontmatter.derive_governance.

purpose.description: What the page is FOR, which is a separate question from who may curate it. 'reference' pages may be cited to a participant; 'generation' pages are seed material for the population generator and must never surface as a participant-facing citation. Without this axis, seed material gets cited as reference knowledge, because editorial standing cannot distinguish them: both are curated.

provenance.description: Per-section grounding tags. W = source-backed, D = demo-invented, I = interpretive. evidence_class is derived from these when not declared outright.

status.description: Deliberately NOT constrained to the editorial vocabulary. One wiki writes status: draft|reviewed|signed_off and means review state; the other writes status: active on a catalogue page and means the catalogue is live. Pinning this key to one of those meanings would be the same name collision this contract exists to avoid, so editorial_standing is the field that carries review state, and status is read as a fallback only when its value already happens to be in that vocabulary.

axes.description: Persona axes this page covers — the market's real dimensions of variation. Read by the generator compiler.

$comment: Four axes rather than one ordering. A page can be upstream-owned, signed off, demo-invented and generation-only all at once; collapsing any pair loses a distinction the retrieval policy needs.
